notes.title: 🚀🐢🐰 Introducing "Run Away" - Where the Unlikely Become Legends! 🎮🌟
notes.notes:
Embark on an epic journey with our cast of tiny and hilarious characters: the speedy humanoid turtle, the hopping bunny, the transparent glass man, and even the one and only Santa Claus! 🐢🐰🎅
[previewyoutube=xhhHDhfnr6M;full][/previewyoutube]
🌈 Dive into a whimsical world where these unlikely heroes face the ultimate challenge: dodging a relentless bull in a bullfighting arena! But that's not all – they're on a mission to collect mystical portals scattered across the arena.

🏗️✨ Unleash Your Creativity: Build Lego Platforms to Soar High! 🏗️✨

Some portals are out of reach, and our heroes won't back down! Harness the power of imagination and build towering Lego platforms to reach new heights. It's not just a game; it's a construction adventure where every brick counts!

🌟 Why "Run Away"? Because Legends Don't Chase, They Lead! 🌟

🚀 Collect as many portals as you can, defy gravity, and outsmart the charging bull to claim victory. Challenge your friends and family in a race to become the ultimate portal-collecting legend!

🌌 Coming Soon to Steam - Wishlist NOW for Exclusive In-Game Bonuses! 🌌

Be part of the journey from the beginning! Wishlist "Run Away" on Steam now and unlock exclusive in-game bonuses when the adventure begins. Your support makes our tiny heroes' dreams come true!

🎁 Spread the Word - Share the Fun! 🎁

Help us make "Run Away" an indie gaming sensation! Share this announcement, tag your gaming squad, and let the countdown to an unforgettable adventure begin!
